title: EXPERIMENT
description: Pre-registration. Committed to workflow/experiments/ BEFORE results exist; the commit timestamp is the pre-registration. Human form: workflow/templates/EXPERIMENT.md. Outcomes are terminal -- one of four tokens plus PENDING, no free-text verdicts (Law 4).

filled.description: A required field must be present, non-empty, and not still hold a <template placeholder>.

OBJECT.description: Exact artifact under test -- HASH, not label (Law 3).

DEPLOYED_FORM.description: How the object is packaged/run for measurement -- must match how it ships.

MEASUREMENT.description: The command/procedure; the sample size and why it is powered for the effect size that would matter.

KILL_BAR.description: Pre-stated threshold for abandoning -- honored regardless of narrative.

COST.description: Estimated spend/time; actual filled in at outcome -- economics get measured.

OUTCOME.description: PENDING before results; then PASS | KILL | NULL | INVALID-INSTRUMENT (+ the measured value, + receipt path). The verdict is the first whitespace-delimited token and must be one of the five; anything after the first whitespace is the measured value and receipt path. Compared case-insensitively (the checker uppercases the token).

INDEPENDENT_REPRO.description: Required for PASS: who reproduced it, from what ref -- author XOR verifier.
